endpoint.selection: Published global endpoint or exact scoped override; no inferred region/pool
endpoint.scope: account or project view, corresponding explicit IAM; no fallback
endpoint.ref_validation: Caller ResourceRef scope/service/generation/kind/endpointID/URL and root shape checked before credential/resource I/O

request.auth: account or project view, corresponding explicit IAM; no fallback
request.body: CreateADBKeyRequest with required nonempty protected publicKey and optional title Unicode length1..255, private wire reveals publicKey unchanged

response.mapping: Typed ADBKey fingerprint/title with exact returned fingerprint ID; no inferred user owner. Explicit caller user parent retained only for user-admin path. Creation scans fingerprint before independent DTO fields; accepted receipt retains trustworthy ID on decode errors.204 must be bodyless.

errors.mapping: Shared SDK status taxonomy, documented400/401/403/404/409 mapped as applicable; provider error message/body omitted; mutation receipt retained on all errors. Missing body/invalid source lengths before credential/HTTP yield revision-bound NotSent receipt.

retry: No replay; one resource attempt on unknown outcome. Documented 4xx rejection statuses retain rejected receipt;500/transport/decode failures preserve uncertainty/acceptance as applicable.

recovery.reason: No direct key Get/status or causal proof contract; caller may explicitly list and match exact ID, no implicit name/public-key lookup/adoption.
